operation_details.item: The user always uses manual spreadsheets with no automation, audit trails, or ERP integration for financial reporting workflows.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! How is the financial planning work going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty well. I’m wrapping up the monthly reporting workflow and updating the budget variance analysis.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Are you using the usual reporting setup, or are you trying anything different this month?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The usual setup. I always use manual spreadsheets for financial reporting, without automation, audit trails, or ERP integration.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives you direct control over the calculations and layout. Does the manual approach work smoothly for your budget and forecast reviews?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, especially when I need to adjust assumptions quickly or inspect every line item myself. I prefer keeping the workflow flexible rather than adding systems that slow me down.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
